status.name: core.roles
status.description: The role definitions of the host in identifier order, each with its text, its Korean text and the files that the agent reads with the role, and the sequence that rises at each change of roles.json; the value changes only when a define or a remove changes the stored definitions.

status.name: core.tab.role
status.description: The role handshake of a tab: the role, the generation, the state pending or ready or null without a role, the change count of this session of the host, the fingerprint of the role file and its path, null without a role.

status.name: core.window.workbench
status.description: The workbench of the window: start identifies one start of the workbench and startedAt is its start time in milliseconds since the epoch (the page identity and the time origin of the main page on a host with a main page); readyState; visibility, hidden while the window is minimized or not shown; scheme, the color scheme of the workbench (dark or light); background, whether the workbench is drawn with the background blur of an open modal; scale, the backing scale of the window; width and height, the content size of the window in points.

status.name: core.window.close
status.description: The close of the window that the host asked for and that the workbench has not ended: step is null while no close is pending, and otherwise registry, tabs, save, commands or close; commands lists the names of the commands that the step commands waits for, in their start order.

status.name: core.screen
status.description: The shown screen of the workbench (the project home or the workspace) and its open modal; the settings tab is a tab, not a modal.

status.name: core.notices
status.description: The notice center: whether it is open, its style and filter, the number of unread entries, whether an unread entry is a warning or an error, the id of the shown entry or null, and the entries in center order, each with id, kind, title, text, source, actions, progress, at, count and read (docs/spec/notifications.md#notices).

status.name: core.toasts
status.description: The shown toasts in order, each with id, kind, title, count and its remaining time in milliseconds, or null while it waits for the person, and listOpen, whether the line form shows the list of its other toasts (docs/spec/notifications.md#commands-and-statuses).

status.name: core.workbench.audit
status.description: Interactive elements of the workbench (button, input, select, textarea, role=button, contenteditable) that are not connected to a declared command or have no element name. Each is {role, expose, command, text}, where role is the ARIA role of the element (its role attribute, else the implicit role of its tag and input type, textbox for contenteditable, null for an input type without one); an empty list means every control runs a command.

status.name: core.activity
status.description: The activities of the window: for each project that the window opened, each of its spaces and each card and group card of a space, the highest activity that it holds, and the activity of each tab, each listed only with an activity (docs/spec/activity.md#status).

status.name: core.projects
status.description: Every saved project with its open state.

status.name: core.project
status.description: The project shown in this window, or null.

status.name: core.layout
status.description: The stored form of the current space layout with the level of each group node, or null.

status.name: core.sidebars
status.description: The drawn sidebars in workbench order: the sidebar (`left`, `right`, `top` or `bottom` for the fixed window sidebar of that side, `<card>:<side>` for an internal card sidebar), placement (`window` or `card`), its set and layout (both null for a fixed window sidebar that shows no set and draws only its status line), horizontal or vertical orientation (horizontal for a top or bottom window sidebar), selected tab or null, the card and active tab its sections receive (for a fixed window sidebar, the focused content card and its active tab while a plugin override applies, otherwise null), the overriding plugin and side of a fixed window sidebar or null, its rectangle, and each section's id, name, fold state, whether its tab text is clipped (always false in list layout), `surfaceId` (the section surface `<space>/<sidebar>/<section>`), `surface` (the surface that the section follows, as the sidebar reports it), its declared `height` (`fill` or pixels), `size` (the height that the person dragged the section to, or null), `mounted` (whether the section view is mounted), `phase` (the page status of the section view or null before its mount) and `error` (its mount error or null).

status.name: core.grid
status.description: The current grid: size, gap, boundary positions, and cards in workbench order with their rectangles in plane coordinates, or null, with each card's tabs (each with the members of a layout tab, tab, plugin, title, active and params, and with the title a surface reported as label, its notice, the footer text it reported, whether it holds unsaved changes as modified, and the operation error it shows as error or null, and the program state it reports as program, {state, pid} or null (docs/spec/program-state.md#status)) and the text its content footer shows as status, tool buttons (enabled, hidden, title), header fit, and effective card sidebars by side with set, size, actual collapsed state, requestedCollapsed, autoCollapsed and collapseReason (null or insufficient-width/insufficient-height); fullscreen is the presented card ID or null, and card rectangles describe current presentation. cards holds the content cards only, each with its tabs, the group card that holds it as parent and whether it leads its level as leader; groups holds the group cards in workbench order with their rectangles, parent, leader and group (name, level, leader), empty without group cards.

status.name: core.sessions
status.description: The owned sessions of this page: each open session with its session identifier, plugin, owner surface, shownBy, the tab that shows it or null, and program, the program state {state} (idle, working or blocked) or null (docs/spec/plugins.md#owned-sessions).

status.name: core.surfaces
status.description: The native surfaces of the current plane with their plugin, visibility, dimming, declared and applied frames in window coordinates, registered entries as "<kind> <name>", and the page status shown in the card status row: phase loading, ready, or error, and the error message. A tab of a plugin that is not loaded is reported with its plugin, visible true and placeholder set to the reason (missing, disabled, reload, refused, host, unread or params); a mounted surface reports placeholder null. state is the memory saver state of the tab: loaded, unloaded or restoring. kind is tab for the surface of a tab, section for a section surface and dialog for the dialog surface, sidebar is the sidebar id of a section surface or null, and dialog is {name, opener} of the dialog surface or null.

status.name: core.tab.memory
status.description: The memory saver of the workbench: the settings memorySaver (enabled) and memorySaverDelay (delay, minutes), the last memory pressure report, and each tab with its state, the reasons that protect it, the time it was hidden, its next delay deadline and the time of the last decision that read the regions. kind is tab for a tab and section for a section surface, which the tab commands refuse.

status.name: core.drop
status.description: The files last dropped on the window: their URLs, the drop point in window points, the surface under the point, the drop command its plugin declares, and the reason when nothing ran.

status.name: core.notifications
status.description: The operating system's permission for this application's notifications the last failure to request permission, post, or remove a notification, and the tabs of the window whose notification the notification center accepted and that were not removed.

status.name: core.settings
status.description: The effective settings, the common value of each setting, the project that project-scope changes apply to, the keys that the project overrides, and whether a change is still being saved.

status.name: core.themes
status.description: The theme catalog in order: each theme's name, shape values, and the color tokens of its dark and light modes.

status.name: core.contributions
status.description: The contributions of the installed and enabled plugins to extension points, resolved when the workbench started, sorted by plugin, point and item: the contributing plugin id, the point as <plugin id>.<point>, the item index, the state (connected, provider-missing, version-mismatch or invalid) and the reason, or null for a connected item.

status.name: core.app
status.description: The application update of the window: the version of the running core or null before the first read, the candidate of the registry index with its version and the page of its release (null when its release URL names no published release) or null, the application update operation with its state (staging, applying or failed), the version and the error, or null, the error of the last read of the registry index or null, and the installed plugins whose engines.soksak does not contain the candidate, by id, each with its installed version, that range and the newest version of the plugin that is not revoked and contains the candidate or null.

status.name: core.plugins
status.description: The plugin cards of the plugin pages of the settings tab: the registry index URL or null, the registry index or plugin state error or null, one entry per loaded, installed or registry plugin sorted by id with its name, description, state (loaded, disabled, available, reload or refused), the loaded surface composition kind or null without a loaded surface declaration, installed version and enabled value or null, newest registry version or null, and sidecars with their range and installed version, the latest plugin operation with its state (running, done or failed) and error, or null, whether a plugin waits for a page reload, the installed plugins whose registry index lists a newer version, the outdated persistent services, and the latest held operation of each plugin with its planned version, its error and the planned version, running version and sessions count of each service that holds it.

status.name: core.setup
status.description: The setup parts that let an agent on the machine learn and reach the application, as the host call setupState returns them in the environment of the login shell of the person: parts of the last read or operation in the order of sok setup check, each with its kind, file, state, step, reason or error when present, changed after an install, and enabled for the desired state of the user PATH registration; [] before the first read; and running, the kinds of the setup operation that runs, or null.

status.name: core.plugin-categories
status.description: The loaded and enabled plugins of each plugin category of core, {category: [{id, name}]}, in the order of their ids (docs/spec/plugins.md#plugin-categories).

status.name: core.accounts
status.description: The accounts of the plugin whose page the settings tab shows, in the order of their names, with the login, the end of the login and the usage lines that the status program of each account printed last, null, null and [] before its first run, and running while its login runs; null while no page of a plugin with accounts shows (docs/spec/plugins.md#accounts).

status.name: core.debug
status.description: The debug view: whether it is open, the path of the state file that opening wrote or null, the files of the logs folder with their path, size in bytes and modification time in milliseconds, the file that the view shows with its kind text or image or null, the timeline of the host event files with its files, the files whose reading stopped at the row limit, whether it follows the growing files and the number of rows appended since it was shown, the greatest seq of each process in the page that showed it and in its last read, the counts of all rows, rows that pass the filter and shown lines with the context rows, the number of selected rows and the warning that a saved file can hold typed text, and its filter or null, the shown state file with its path, the number of tree lines, the state file it is compared with or null and the number of differences, or null, the scroll position of the shown content in points, the running or last save operation with, for a save of the logs folder, the bytes written and the bytes listed, and the error of the last failed step or operation or null.

status.name: core.picker
status.description: Whether the add, tab, tool or space apps menu is open, its title, its items in order and its group headings in order; group is the card of an item in a grouped menu and null otherwise, and a heading reports the card id, its name and its indentation depth.

status.name: core.verify
status.description: The latest layout verification: the rows that measured something, the number of failed rows and the checks skipped because they had nothing to measure in this state, or null before the first verification.

status.name: core.surface.document
status.description: Registered by every plugin surface page: its address, time origin, ready state, whether the first theme is applied, device pixel ratio, body and viewport sizes, and the root filter, and the page's interactive elements without a command binding or element name (`unbound`, as in core.workbench.audit).

status.name: core.surface.input
status.description: Registered by every plugin surface page: its last 32 pointer, click, wheel, and key events in order, with the modifier keys each event carries.

status.name: core.modal
status.description: The open native modal of this window, or null; document, the state that the modal document reported, is reported only on a host that creates modal web views. An open dialog surface is the modal of the mode dialog with the dialog surface as id, document null and its plugin as plugin; a native modal reports plugin null.

status.name: core.drag
status.description: The tab drag in progress: the dragged tab, its card, whether it moved, the drop target with the tab index of a tab strip, and the drop preview in plane coordinates; null without a drag.

status.name: core.rename
status.description: The tab being renamed in place: its kind, id, and current input value; null when nothing is renamed.

status.name: core.plugin.open-calls
status.description: The open calls of each plugin: `{plugin, count, oldestStartedAt}`, where oldestStartedAt is the start time of the oldest open call, or null without open calls.

status.name: core.plugin.losses
status.description: The counts of each plugin's losses kept until the application ends: `{plugin, abandoned, lateReplies, peerLost}`, one count per kind of loss in the plugin process design.

status.name: core.plugin.views
status.description: The responsiveness of each plugin view surface: `{plugin, surface, responsive}`, where responsive is false while the view process does not answer WebKit's responsiveness check.

status.name: core.pointer
status.description: The last pointer sequence that the workbench received: a press increments sequence, and down, up and click name the exposed element (or tag) that received pointerdown, pointerup and click; pressedConnected tells whether the pressed element was still in the document at pointerup. A click is missing when the pressed element was replaced before the release.

status.name: core.focus
status.description: The exposed element that has keyboard focus in the part of the window that holds the first responder: the workbench, including surface modules mounted in shadow roots, or the document of a view surface, which reports its element; its name, its index within its own document or shadow root, and the surface id (null in the workbench); null when focus is elsewhere or a document region, modal or native view holds the first responder. Changes with every focus transition and first responder change.

status.name: core.text
status.description: The text size scope and factors: the frame factor and each card's factor.

status.name: core.chrome
status.description: The window chrome: the width reserved for the window's own buttons and where the project tabs stand.

status.name: core.rail
status.description: The rail outline path in plane coordinates, the groups that each join a content card with the fixed window sidebars of any side that its plugin overrides, and the focus corner mark rectangle; null without a layout.

status.name: core.home
status.description: The project home: the search text, the selected project id or null, the project ids of the rows in the order shown, and the preview and folder errors of each project by id.

status.name: core.settings-tab
status.description: The settings tab of the window, or null while the window has no settings tab: the shown page, the scope, the menu search, the installed-plugin search and filter, the state of 찾아보기, the listed plugins, the plugin action buttons, the shown plugin and the page that its back link returns to, the edited set, the plugin setting rows, the controls with their values, the scroll position, the undo toast, the open confirmation, the error lines, the search results and the plugin settings whose value names no loaded plugin.

commands.name: core.settings.set
commands.description: Changes settings in the common or project scope and resolves after the change is saved.

commands.name: core.settings.reset
commands.description: Removes the project override of one setting; scope names the project scope, the only scope that holds an override.

commands.name: core.settings.debug
commands.description: Turns the 디버그 switch on or off. On sets diagnostics.performance to true and every class of diagnostics.log to trace; off sets diagnostics.performance to false and diagnostics.log to {}, which stores only the errors. Both are common settings.

commands.name: core.setup.check
commands.description: Reads the setup parts again through the host call setupState and answers them; fails with the host error, and with setup operations need a native host without a host.

commands.name: core.setup.install
commands.description: Installs the setup parts of the named kinds, a non-empty list of skill and mcp without repetition, through the host call setupInstall, as sok setup install does, and answers the parts after the install; fails with -32602 for another list, with the host error when the install fails or another runs, and with setup operations need a native host without a host.

commands.name: core.setup.change
commands.description: Saves and applies the desired state of the user PATH registration through setupChange and answers the resulting parts.

commands.name: core.accounts.add
commands.description: Creates the home of a new account of a plugin with the least free identifier account-<n>, stores the account {id, name, kind} in the plugin key accounts and answers {id}; it refuses a plugin without accounts, a name that is not 1 to 40 characters without a control character, a used name and an undeclared kind.

commands.name: core.accounts.rename
commands.description: Changes the name of an account of a plugin and keeps its identifier and its home; it refuses an undefined account, an invalid or used name and an account whose login runs.

commands.name: core.accounts.remove
commands.description: Removes an account of a plugin from the plugin key accounts and removes its home; it refuses an undefined account and an account whose login runs.

commands.name: core.accounts.login
commands.description: Runs the login program of the plugin for an account in its home, which opens the default browser of the system, and answers when the login ends; a cancelled login answers null. It refuses an account whose login runs.

commands.name: core.accounts.login-cancel
commands.description: Ends the login that runs for an account of a plugin; it refuses an account whose login does not run.

commands.name: core.accounts.logout
commands.description: Runs the logout program of the plugin for an account in its home; it refuses an account whose login runs.

commands.name: core.settings.open
commands.description: Opens the settings tab.

commands.name: core.settings.close
commands.description: Closes the settings tab and brings the work screen of the window to the front.

commands.name: core.debug.open
commands.description: Closes the settings tab, opens the debug view, records the state of every window into the logs folder and lists the files of the logs folder.

commands.name: core.debug.close
commands.description: Closes the debug view.

commands.name: core.debug.save
commands.description: Saves one file of the logs folder through the save panel where the person chooses; answers the chosen path, or null when the person cancels.

commands.name: core.debug.timeline.save
commands.description: Saves the text lines of the selected rows of the shown debug timeline, in timeline order and one line each, through the save panel as soksak-timeline-<UTC time>.txt where the person chooses; answers the chosen path, or null when the person cancels. A selection without a row is an error. The saved file can hold typed text.

commands.name: core.debug.save-all
commands.description: Saves the logs folder as one gzip-compressed tar file through the save panel where the person chooses; answers the chosen path, or null when the person cancels.

commands.name: core.debug.view
commands.description: Shows the content of one text file of the logs folder in the open debug view: the whole file, or its last 262144 bytes.

commands.name: core.debug.list
commands.description: Shows the list of the files of the logs folder again in the open debug view.

commands.name: core.debug.state
commands.description: Shows one state file of the logs folder as a tree of its keys and values in the open debug view; a file that is not a state file of the list, or whose content is not a state, is an error.

commands.name: core.debug.state.compare
commands.description: Compares the shown state file with the state file at with and lists the paths whose values differ; an empty with ends the comparison; a with that is not another state file of the list is an error.

commands.name: core.debug.timeline
commands.description: Shows the newest page of the events of the event files of the logs folder in the open debug view, asked from the host through the query; a file that breaks the event structure is an error.

commands.name: core.debug.timeline.follow
commands.description: Stops or resumes following the event files in the shown debug timeline: with on true the timeline first asks for the rows that were written while it was stopped and then adds the rows that later change notices report, with on false it adds nothing; the same call again changes nothing, and a query that fails stops following.

commands.name: core.debug.timeline.older
commands.description: Asks for the page of events before the oldest row that the shown debug timeline holds and puts it in front of the rows; it changes nothing when no older row exists, and it is an error when the timeline already holds 2000 rows.

commands.name: core.debug.timeline.select
commands.description: Selects or unselects one row of the shown debug timeline: row is its position among the rows that the view holds from 0, in key order at the time of the call, and selected is true or false; the same call again changes nothing. A selection stays on its row when other rows come in front or leave.

commands.name: core.debug.timeline.context
commands.description: Brings the rows around one row of the shown debug timeline into the held rows: row is its position among the rows that the view holds from 0, in key order at the time of the call; the 5 rows before it and the 5 rows after it in the channel of the filter are asked for whatever the other members of the filter are, and the rows that were not held are shown as context, indented by two spaces. A new filter shows its own rows only.

commands.name: core.debug.timeline.filter
commands.description: Sets the filter of the shown debug timeline and asks for its newest page again: channel is other, debug or all, level is the least severe level shown, class is a class, layer is a layer or all, text is a case-insensitive part of the line, event is the exact event name, event_prefix is an event name or the first part of one that ends before a dot, surface and session are whole identifiers, cid is one correlation identifier, run is a run identifier, and from and to are inclusive UTC times like 2026-10-08T22:53:20.123456Z; an empty text leaves class, text, event, event_prefix, surface, session, cid, run, from or to open. A member that is not given keeps its value; at least one member is required.

commands.name: core.projects.browse
commands.description: Shows the project home in this window while keeping its current work.

commands.name: core.projects.flush
commands.description: Saves the current layout, settings, and window geometry.

commands.name: core.project.open
commands.description: Registers the directory as a project with a fresh layout and opens it; returns the project.

commands.name: core.project.activate
commands.description: Opens a saved project.

commands.name: core.project.close
commands.description: Closes and removes a project. A window that shows the project asks about each modified tab first, and keeping a tab keeps the project: the result is closed false.

commands.name: core.project.rename
commands.description: Renames a project.

commands.name: core.project.move
commands.description: Moves a project in the saved order by delta positions.

commands.name: core.project.pin
commands.description: Pins or unpins a project.

commands.name: core.window.new
commands.description: Opens a new unassigned window.

commands.name: core.folder.create
commands.description: Creates a project folder through the host and returns its root and identity.

commands.name: core.space.add
commands.description: Adds a space with a fresh layout, shows it, and returns its id and title.

commands.name: core.space.activate
commands.description: Shows a space of the current project.

commands.name: core.space.rename
commands.description: Renames a space of the current project.

commands.name: core.space.close
commands.description: Closes a space of the current project; the last space does not close. A modified tab of the active space is not closed until the workbench asks whether to save, discard or keep it, and keeping it leaves the space open. The result is closed false when the space stays.

commands.name: core.grid.size
commands.description: Sets the width or height of a card on an axis and redraws.

commands.name: core.boundary.move
commands.description: Moves boundary line on axis to a position in plane coordinates and redraws; returns the resulting position.

commands.name: core.boundary.center
commands.description: Centres boundary line on axis between its neighbouring lines, as a double click or Enter on its divider does, and redraws; returns the resulting position.

commands.name: core.layout.balance
commands.description: Gives every card of the current space a fair share of the plane and keeps the arrangement; a cut gives its sides room in proportion to the cards they hold along its axis, counted on their fullest row.

commands.name: core.settings.change
commands.description: Sets one setting from a control value; strings are converted to the setting's type. Without scope it sets the common value.

commands.name: core.settings.choose-folder
commands.description: Chooses a folder with the system dialog and sets it as the value of key in scope; a cancelled dialog changes nothing.

commands.name: core.settings.theme
commands.description: Applies a theme with its shape values in the given mode (the current mode by default) and scope (common by default).

commands.name: core.settings.link
commands.description: Changes a general window, plugin window, or card-side choice. A set ID selects a set; off removes the link. Window choices have no inheritance.

commands.name: core.settings.sets.create
commands.description: Adds a sidebar set titled 새 세트 with layout list and no sections to the scope, opens it for editing when settings are open, and returns its id.

commands.name: core.settings.sets.update
commands.description: Changes the title or the layout of a sidebar set in the scope; a rejected change fails with invalid params.

commands.name: core.settings.sets.row
commands.description: Changes one section row of a sidebar set in the scope: remove deletes row index, and add appends section. A section that is not registered or that the set already has fails with invalid params.

commands.name: core.settings.sets.delete
commands.description: Removes a sidebar set and every link to it in the scope in one change.

commands.name: core.plugins.install
commands.description: Installs a plugin from the registry index through the host, as sok plugin install does; the host applies the change to its sidecars and every window starts its workbench again after the questions of its modified tabs. With end true it runs an operation that a running persistent service holds and ends that service first; end other than true is refused.

commands.name: core.plugins.update
commands.description: Installs the selected version of an installed plugin through the host, as sok plugin update does; the host applies the change to its sidecars and every window starts its workbench again after the questions of its modified tabs. With end true it runs an operation that a running persistent service holds and ends that service first; end other than true is refused.

commands.name: core.plugins.remove
commands.description: Removes an installed plugin through the host, as sok plugin remove does; the host applies the change to its sidecars and every window starts its workbench again after the questions of its modified tabs.

commands.name: core.plugins.enable
commands.description: Enables an installed plugin through the host, as sok plugin enable does; the host applies the change to its sidecars and every window starts its workbench again after the questions of its modified tabs. With end true it runs an operation that a running persistent service holds and ends that service first; end other than true is refused.

commands.name: core.plugins.disable
commands.description: Disables an installed plugin through the host, as sok plugin disable does; the host applies the change to its sidecars and every window starts its workbench again after the questions of its modified tabs.

commands.name: core.plugins.apply
commands.description: Asks for each modified tab of the window whether to save it, discard its changes or keep the workbench, then saves the projects and starts the workbench of the window again so that it loads the plugins that installed.json lists, answering reloaded true before the new start; answers reloaded false when a tab is kept.

commands.name: core.plugins.show-updates
commands.description: Opens the settings tab on the page 설치됨 with the filter 업데이트.

commands.name: core.app.update
commands.description: Downloads, checks and extracts the release of the candidate application update, then replaces the application bundle and starts the application again; the operation of core.app reports the step, and a failed step rejects with its message. It fails when the registry index lists no candidate.

commands.name: core.app.release
commands.description: Opens the release page of the candidate application update in the default application of the person; it fails when the candidate has no release page.

commands.name: core.plugins.update-all
commands.description: Updates the plugins that the registry lists in a newer version, in id order, one after the other, and reads the plugin state again after each; stops at the first failure with the host error and does nothing when no plugin has an update.

commands.name: core.plugins.replace
commands.description: Replaces the outdated persistent service of a sidecar after its sessions end, as the plugin screen offers, and reads the outdated sidecars again; fails with the host error when the sidecar has no running service of another version.

commands.name: core.plugins.registry
commands.description: Sets the registry index that plugin operations read, through the host, as sok registry use does, and reads the plugin state again.

commands.name: core.plugins.browse
commands.description: Opens the settings tab on the page 설치됨.

commands.name: core.text.larger
commands.description: Enlarges the text of the current text size scope: the last pressed card, or the frame and every card.

commands.name: core.text.smaller
commands.description: Reduces the text of the current text size scope.

commands.name: core.text.reset
commands.description: Restores the text of the current text size scope to factor 1.

commands.name: core.card.focus
commands.description: Focuses a card: a content card, the first content card inside a group card, or no card with null, which clears the focus as a press outside every content card does.

commands.name: core.card.fullscreen
commands.description: Shows a content card or a group card across the work area, or restores the arrangement.

commands.name: core.card.menu
commands.description: Opens or closes the add, split or group split menu of a card, or the split or group split menu of a group card.

commands.name: core.card.sidebar.set
commands.description: Assigns a set, disables the side with off, or restores the plugin default with inherit.

commands.name: core.card.sidebar.toggle
commands.description: Folds or unfolds one card sidebar without changing the card size.

commands.name: core.card.sidebar.size
commands.description: Sets one card sidebar width or height within the configured bounds.

commands.name: core.sidebar.section.select
commands.description: Shows one section of a sidebar whose set uses the tabs layout; the selection is kept for that sidebar.

commands.name: core.sidebar.section.size
commands.description: Sets the heights of sections of a vertical sidebar whose set uses the list layout, all at once: heights maps the id of each section to an integer from 32 to 4096 pixels. The heights are kept for that sidebar and saved with the space; a drag of a divider sets the two sections beside it.

commands.name: core.sidebar.section.fold
commands.description: Folds or unfolds one section of a sidebar whose set uses the list layout; the state is kept for that sidebar.

commands.name: core.card.tab-list
commands.description: Opens or closes a card's tab list.

commands.name: core.card.tools
commands.description: Opens or closes the tool menu of a card or a group card, which a narrow header shows instead of its tools; its items run the same commands as the sidebar buttons and the enabled tools.

commands.name: core.space.apps
commands.description: Opens or closes the space apps list of a fullscreen card: every tab of the space in groups by card, in the order of the tree of cuts of the arrangement; picking a tab moves fullscreen to its card and shows it.

commands.name: core.surface.menu
commands.description: Opens the context menu that the plugin of a surface declares in surface.menu, in the selection layer at x and y of the window; picking an item runs its command on that surface. A surface whose plugin declares no menu is refused.

commands.name: core.file.place
commands.description: Asks the person where to save a new document of the project of the window: the save panel opens in the project root with name as the file name, and the answer is the chosen file relative to the project root, or null when the person cancelled.

commands.name: core.file.open
commands.description: Opens the file at path, relative to the project root, in the loaded plugin whose surface.opens declares its extension: activates the tab of that plugin with the same path in the space, or adds a tab with params {path} to card or to the focused card. The path is stored and compared in its normal form, without . segments, empty segments or a final / and in Unicode NFC.

commands.name: core.card.add-tab
commands.description: Adds a tab of a plugin to a card and activates it. params, when given, must match the plugin's surface.params and are stored with the tab.

commands.name: core.card.split
commands.description: Splits a card and puts a new tab of a plugin in a new card on the named side of it: left, right, top, or bottom.

commands.name: core.group.create
commands.description: Groups a card with a new content card toward side.

commands.name: core.group.dissolve
commands.description: Replaces a group card with its members in the level that holds it.

commands.name: core.group.rename
commands.description: Renames a group card.

commands.name: core.group.leader
commands.description: Makes a card the leader of its level.

commands.name: core.group.menu
commands.description: Opens or closes the close menu of a group header.

commands.name: core.card.move
commands.description: Moves a content card or a group card beside a card, a box, a cut or a run of any level, named by one identifier or a list, into a group, or into the place of a content card, which takes its place, or joins every tab of a content card to the tab strip of a content card at index, as a drop does.

commands.name: core.card.get
commands.description: Reads the state of one content card of any level with its group path, or one group card.

commands.name: core.card.close
commands.description: Closes a card with all its tabs. When a tab of the card is modified, the workbench asks about that tab first, the result is closed false, and the card closes after its modified tabs are saved or discarded.

commands.name: core.session.open
commands.description: Opens an owned session of plugin with params in a size of the width and height of a card in points and the backing scale of the window, owned by the calling surface, which the sidecar of the plugin opens; the result is {session}. The session opens with its size whatever the occlusion of the window (docs/spec/plugins.md#owned-sessions).

commands.name: core.session.resize
commands.description: Sets the size of an open session to the width, height and backing scale of a card. While no tab shows the session, only its owner may resize it (docs/spec/plugins.md#owned-sessions).

commands.name: core.session.end
commands.description: Ends an open owned session. Only its owner surface may end it (docs/spec/plugins.md#owned-sessions).

commands.name: core.session.input
commands.description: Types text into an open owned session as given, without any change to its characters. Only its owner surface may call it; the result is {} (docs/spec/plugins.md#owned-sessions).

commands.name: core.session.submit
commands.description: Pastes text into an open owned session and then sends Enter. The text must not contain CR or LF. Only its owner surface may call it; the result is {} (docs/spec/plugins.md#owned-sessions).

commands.name: core.session.read
commands.description: Reads the screen of an open owned session: {from, rows, cursor}, where from is the absolute line number of the first row, numbered as the from of a read with from and count, rows are the visible rows as text, top row first, and cursor is the zero-based {row, column} of the cursor in rows. With from and count, which are required together, it reads count retained rows from the absolute line number from instead and answers {from, count, rows}; from is an integer of 0 or more and count an integer from 1 to 200. Only its owner surface may call it (docs/spec/plugins.md#owned-sessions).

commands.name: core.layout.open
commands.description: Opens a tab of plugin with params, or of the plugin that opens the extension of path with params {path} in the normal form of the path, in card, or with side in the neighbour of card toward side: selects the first tab of the plugin whose params equal the given ones as JSON values, else adds the tab to card or splits card toward side into a new card with the tab. card is a card identifier or current, the focused card. The result names the card and the tab, selected and its card focused; the same operation applied again answers the same.

commands.name: core.layout.select
commands.description: Makes a tab the active tab of its card and focuses the card; tab is a tab identifier or current, the active tab of the focused card. A tab that is already active and focused is left as it is.

commands.name: core.layout.move
commands.description: Moves an existing tab, with its surface, into card, or with side into the neighbour of card toward side: a target that already holds the tab selects it, else the tab joins card as a drop on its centre does or card splits toward side into a new card with the tab, and the only tab of a card moves its card. tab is a tab identifier or current and card a card identifier or current. The tab never closes; the result names its card and the tab, selected and its card focused, and the same operation applied again answers the same.

commands.name: core.layout.plan
commands.description: Plans a whole arrangement of the active space without changing it: tree, a split {direction: row or column, children} or a card {tabs, active?} whose entries are {tab} or {plugin, params?}, or count cards of plugin with params in the most even grid. close true closes the tabs that the tree does not hold; else they stay as inactive tabs of the first card. The result states whether the operations of the size rule can build it, the tree as an apply takes it, the cards in reading order with their frames, the plane and the minimum card size; an arrangement that is not feasible states the reason, the plane that it needs and a proposal of the nearest arrangement that can be built.

commands.name: core.layout.apply
commands.description: Builds the plan of tree in the active space with the operations of the size rule, as core.layout.plan states it: the existing tabs move into their cards with their surfaces, the new tabs open, the tabs of closed close and the first card of the tree is focused. A plan that is not feasible changes nothing and fails with its reason; the same tree applied again changes nothing and answers the same.

commands.name: core.layout.close
commands.description: Closes a tab as its close control does, and a card without tabs closes; tab is a tab identifier or current. A tab with unsaved changes opens the question of the close control and the result is closed false at once; a tab that this window closed since its workbench started answers closed true and changes nothing.

commands.name: core.sidebar.toggle
commands.description: Shows or hides one window sidebar: negates the setting of its side and writes it to the scope of the applied value (docs/spec/external-sidebars.md#window-tools).

commands.name: core.notices.toggle
commands.description: Opens or closes the notice center (docs/spec/notifications.md#commands-and-statuses).

commands.name: core.notices.filter
commands.description: Sets the filter of the notice center: all, problems (warning and error) or progress.

commands.name: core.notices.read-all
commands.description: Marks every entry of the notice center read.

commands.name: core.notices.clear
commands.description: Removes the entries of one group of the notice center: today, yesterday or a day as YYYY-MM-DD.

commands.name: core.notices.clear-all
commands.description: Removes every entry of the notice center.

commands.name: core.notices.show
commands.description: Opens the notice center, scrolled to the entry of the notice id and marking that entry as the shown entry; an id that no entry has fails with -32602, which names the id.

commands.name: core.toasts.list
commands.description: Shows (open true) or hides (open false) the other toasts of the line form as a column under the line; Escape and a second press on the count also hide it.

commands.name: core.notices.close
commands.description: Closes the toast and the status line notice of the notice id and keeps its entry; an id that no shown notice has fails with -32602.

commands.name: core.notices.add
commands.description: Gives the card card, or the plugin plugin, a notice with the fields of tab.notify and returns its id; exactly one of card and plugin is given. A card or plugin that does not exist and a field that tab.notify refuses fail with -32602.

commands.name: core.notices.progress
commands.description: Sets the progress of a progress notice, as tab.progress does; an id that is not a progress notice fails with -32602.

commands.name: core.notices.done
commands.description: Ends a progress notice as success or error, as tab.done does; an id that is not a progress notice fails with -32602.

commands.name: core.notices.read
commands.description: Marks one entry of the notice center read; an id that no entry has fails with -32602.

commands.name: core.tab.role
commands.description: Sets the agent role of a tab: null clears the role. The answer is the role status of the tab.

commands.name: core.tab.role.confirm
commands.description: Confirms the fingerprint of the role file of the tab of the caller, which gives the ready state.

commands.name: core.role.define
commands.description: Defines a role or changes the definition of the role with the identifier: the text, the Korean text and the absolute paths of the files that the agent reads with the role. A change of roles.json notifies every window, and each tab that holds the role receives the change. The answer is the stored definition.

commands.name: core.role.remove
commands.description: Removes the definition of a role that no tab uses. A role that is not defined or that a tab uses is refused, and nothing is written.

commands.name: core.tab.select
commands.description: Activates a tab and focuses its card.

commands.name: core.tab.close
commands.description: Closes a tab; the last tab closes its card when the card can close. A modified tab is not closed: the workbench asks whether to save, discard or keep it, and the result is closed false.

commands.name: core.tab.move
commands.description: Moves a tab to the centre (as a tab at the end) or to the tab strip (as a tab at index) of a card, or to an edge (as a new card) of a card, a box, a cut or a run named by one identifier or a list, as a drop does.

commands.name: core.tab.unload
commands.description: Unloads a hidden tab now. It does not wait for recent, media, media-unknown, capture or form, and fails with tab <id> is protected: <reasons> for the other reasons and for the reasons that ended the attempt.

commands.name: core.tab.reload
commands.description: Restarts the view of a tab: the host ends its view and creates it again, clears its restart stop, and counts no failure. It answers the tab; a tab without a view fails with an error that names the tab.

commands.name: core.tab.keep
commands.description: Sets (true) or clears (false) the mark kept of a tab and stores it in tab-state.json; it fails for a tab that can never be unloaded.

commands.name: core.tab.menu
commands.description: Opens the context menu of a tab in the selection layer at x and y of the window; its keep item runs core.tab.keep with the toggled mark. A tab whose menu has no item, a tab that can never be unloaded, is refused.

commands.name: core.picker.pick
commands.description: Picks an item of the open menu by index.

commands.name: core.picker.close
commands.description: Closes the open menu without picking.

commands.name: core.modal.dismiss
commands.description: Closes the open native menu without picking. Escape in the menu answers with this command.

commands.name: core.rename.begin
commands.description: Starts renaming a project or space tab, or a group name, in place.

commands.name: core.rename.set
commands.description: Sets the value of the tab being renamed.

commands.name: core.rename.commit
commands.description: Saves the new name; an empty name keeps the old one.

commands.name: core.rename.cancel
commands.description: Stops renaming without saving.

commands.name: core.focus.set
commands.description: Gives keyboard focus to an exposed element of the workbench.

commands.name: core.surface.hit
commands.description: Registered by every plugin surface page: whether an element of the document is at the point in CSS pixels.

commands.name: core.surface.clock
commands.description: Registered by every plugin surface page: the page identity of the document, and the time origin and the current time of the document clock in milliseconds, which a check reads to map document times to the host clock.

commands.name: core.home.back
commands.description: Restores the work screen of the window from the project home (docs/spec/projects.md#project-home). It fails when the window has no work screen to return to.

commands.name: core.home.show
commands.description: Shows the project home in this window while keeping its current work.

commands.name: core.home.search
commands.description: Sets the project home search text and filters the rows by name and path.

commands.name: core.home.search.focus
commands.description: Focuses the search field of the project home.

commands.name: core.home.select
commands.description: Moves the selected row of the project home by one step, wrapping at the ends of the list.

commands.name: core.home.open
commands.description: Opens a project in this window in place. Without a project, it opens the selected row.

commands.name: core.home.form.open
commands.description: Opens the project home form that creates a project folder (create), adopts an existing folder (open) or clones a Git repository (import).

commands.name: core.home.form.set
commands.description: Sets a field of the project home form.

commands.name: core.home.form.submit
commands.description: Submits the project home form: creates the folder when asked, then opens it as a project.

commands.name: core.home.form.cancel
commands.description: Closes the project home form.

commands.name: core.home.choose-folder
commands.description: Asks for a folder with the system dialog and puts it in the form's parent field.

commands.name: core.home.pin
commands.description: Pins or unpins a project on the project home.

commands.name: core.home.confirm
commands.description: Puts a row of the project home into its removal confirm state (ask), cancels it (no) or confirms the removal from the list (yes).

commands.name: core.home.remove
commands.description: Removes a project from the registry and its spaces; the folder is not changed.

commands.name: core.settings-tab.nav
commands.description: Shows a page of the settings tab, and scrolls the named group of the page into view.

commands.name: core.settings-tab.scope
commands.description: Shows the common or project scope in the settings tab.

commands.name: core.settings-tab.plugin
commands.description: Opens the page of a loaded plugin in the settings tab; a null plugin returns to the list.

commands.name: core.settings-tab.search
commands.description: Sets the plugin search text of the settings tab; the list shows loaded plugins whose id, name, or description contains it, ignoring letter case.

commands.name: core.settings-tab.account-name
commands.description: Sets the text of the name field of the row 새 계정 of the shown plugin page with accounts.

commands.name: core.settings-tab.account-kind
commands.description: Sets the kind of the row 새 계정 of the shown plugin page with accounts to a declared kind.

commands.name: core.settings-tab.account-edit
commands.description: Shows the name field of an account of the shown plugin page with its name, or ends the edit with null.

commands.name: core.settings-tab.account-edit-name
commands.description: Sets the text of the name field of the account whose name the shown plugin page edits.

commands.name: core.settings-tab.edit
commands.description: Opens the editor of a sidebar set in the settings tab; a null set closes the editor.

commands.name: core.settings-tab.find
commands.description: Sets the text of the menu search of the settings tab; an empty text ends the search.

commands.name: core.settings-tab.filter
commands.description: Sets the filter of the page 설치됨.

commands.name: core.settings-tab.browse
commands.description: Sets the search text or the switch of the page 찾아보기, or shows the next rows with more.

commands.name: core.settings-tab.undo
commands.description: Restores the value before the change that the undo toast shows.

commands.name: core.settings-tab.back
commands.description: Returns from the plugin page to the page that opened it.

commands.name: core.settings-tab.confirm
commands.description: Asks, accepts or declines the confirmation of a set or plugin removal.
